items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: then they had Baron Lee; he was the third leader that I know of.

ctx.x: Yeah, they had a lot of different leaders in front of the band. They started off with Carroll Dickerson from Chicago. He was the first leader, I think, in front of the band. Then they come up with another fellow named Sonny something-or-other, but he didn't last either... Q: Sonny Adams? You mentioned Sonny Adams. Was that the name?

No. Sonny Adams was a tenor player. But this leader's name was Sonny something. Well, anyway, then they had Baron Lee; he was the third leader that I know of. And after that, I don't know, because I was out of the band this time -- I was gone again. Then I think Lucky Millinder was about the last one that was in front of the band. It was still the Blue Rhythm Band when Lucky Millinder taken it over.
Now, you mentioned that everybody wanted to be a leader.
